_meta.description: AGOS v2 prototype dataset for the normalized schema in backend/models_v2.py. NOT loaded by the running app (backend/main.py + seed.py use the flat data/seed.json instead) — this file exists only as a reference for a possible future pilot-phase migration.
_meta.status: PROTOTYPE — UNUSED BY THE LIVE APP
sources: Barangay list, 2020 CPH population figures, and city PSGC code: PSA 2020 Census of Population and Housing, cross-checked via PhilAtlas (philatlas.com/luzon/r04a/laguna/cabuyao.html) and the city's Wikipedia infobox. Populations sum to the official city total of 355,330.
Lakeshore barangay classification: Cabuyao city article (Wikipedia) — six barangays front Laguna de Bay: Bigaa, Butong, Marinig, Gulod, Baclaran, Mamatid.
Street names/coordinates: OpenStreetMap (Overpass API), each barangay assignment independently confirmed via Nominatim reverse geocoding of the OSM coordinate (not assumed from the street name).
Street elevation: SRTM 90m DEM via the OpenTopoData API (coarse resolution — treat as indicative, not survey-grade).
known_gaps: Individual barangay-level 10-digit PSGC codes could not be verified from an accessible public source in this session (PSA's own PSGC lookup and its FOI barangay-PSGC page both blocked automated access). Left null rather than invented — look them up from the official PSGC Excel publication before relying on them.

Street-level demographic/vulnerability data (residents, seniors, children, pregnant, PWD per street) and per-street risk assessments have been removed from this file. PSA does not publish population data below barangay level, so any street-level breakdown would be fabricated. Per docs/scope.md, real CDRRMO-validated demographic data is an explicit pilot-phase deliverable, not something to synthesize here. backend/scoring.py's vulnerability_score() still works from barangay-level totals if needed.

A prior version of this file cited fake OSM way IDs, a wrong PSGC city code, barangay populations off by up to -77%/+457% from the real 2020 census, and placed Felix Limcaoco Street in Marinig when it is actually in Barangay Dos (Poblacion II) — none of that carried forward.

Marinig (3 streets) and Niugan (2 streets) have fewer than the 4-5 found for most other barangays; Casile has only 1. OSM street-level tagging is sparse for these three even after multiple targeted searches (admin-boundary queries, centroid searches) — not fabricated to hit a uniform count.
